metadata.purpose: measure whether activation-outlier separation admits more steps to DEWA normal_add
metadata.dewa_rule: delta=E_new-E_acc(t); skip_new if delta<=-T; replace_old if delta>=T; otherwise normal_add
metadata.raw_path: raw FP16 layer input -> activation BFP4 -> ordered Group-16 DEWA trajectory
metadata.clean_path: raw FP16 outliers zeroed -> normal activation BFP4 -> independent ordered Group-16 DEWA trajectory
metadata.exception_path: cost accounting only; outlier arithmetic and recombination are not modeled
metadata.weight_path: same already-BFP4-quantized weight for raw and clean paths
